label: PF Backlog 109
title: Agent context & cost efficiency
body:
Backend epic: agent context & cost efficiency (measure -> optimize). Consolidates 8 items that were reading as unrelated so they are planned/executed as ONE workstream.

Children:
- BI-0094 - telemetry/metrics (Prometheus /metrics + per-agent context/cost telemetry: prompt tokens, prefix_cache_hit_rate, assembly_ms, retries) - the GATE every other child depends on.
- BI-0101 - prompt assembly: stable-prefix ordering to exploit provider prompt caching.
- BI-0102 - context: per-phase handoff digest / context snapshot (replace raw artifact re-reads).
- BI-0103 - context: collapse duplicate context-assembly paths + extend InputCache to the package.
- BI-0104 - delegation: pass a pre-built context bundle + fingerprint to sub-agents.
- BI-0105 - ContextEngine: wire into runtime OR delete (single context design).
- BI-0106 - runtime: parallelize independent agents with bounded concurrency.
- BI-0107 - code agents: bound tool loops + seed a file map (anti-exploration).

Order: BI-0094 (instrument/measure) first; BI-0101..BI-0107 depend on it (deps set).

dashboard_impact.reason: umbrella epic; each child carries its own dashboard_impact decision

_note: done: epic envelope; all children (BI-0100..0107) completed
